profileLabel: Center-left economics; liberal social values; mixed civil liberties (low confidence)
summary: Negros Occidental 3rd District representative with 224 principal-authored bills. Authored SOGIESC anti-discrimination, a general anti-discrimination bill, anti-retroviral access for mature minors without parental consent, free menstrual products, medical parole for elderly prisoners, service incentive leave and freelancer protections, alongside tax holidays for films and minors' social-media regulation.
caveat: Direction and safeguards of the wiretapping update, social-media, deepfake and medical-parole bills were not read in full. Bill-based evidence; no votes.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Freelancer protections, higher service incentive leave and telecommuting for public employees (labor, -2); mixed tax bills: film income tax holiday and athlete exemptions (+1 to +2) versus a higher individual exemption ceiling (-1).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB00311, HB10237, HB06802, HB06345, HB02792, HB10678 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Authored SOGIESC and general anti-discrimination bills (+4), anti-retroviral access for mature minors without parental consent (+3), and free menstrual products with electronic violence against women definitions (+2).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB05266, HB00714, HB00690, HB10239, HB06812 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Mixed
civil.rationale: Medical parole for elderly prisoners (+2) against minors' social-media regulation (-1) and deepfake accountability (-1); wiretap-law update not scored (direction unverified). Mixed and sparse.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB02791, HB03821, HB03823 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Insufficient evidence
democratic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
